## Appearance

Charlie Sloane is known for his prominent, goggle eyes. His eyes are notably striking and distinct even when seen in the moonlight.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023), [v3 ch.Autumn P6](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0006), [v3 ch.Park P9](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0009)_

## Personality

Charlie Sloane harbors long-standing romantic feelings for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). He also aims to pursue a career in politics with the goal of becoming a member of Parliament.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## History

Charlie Sloane attended school alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), once telling his mother that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was the smartest girl in school and fighting [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md) over a remark about her. He later attended a farewell party thrown by the A. V. I. S. for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before their departure for college, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) found his company dull.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v3 ch.Autumn P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 ch.Autumn P6](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0006), [v3 ch.Autumn P11](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0011), [v3 ch.Autumn P38](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0038), +12 more_

## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlie-sloane--gilbert-blythe.md)

Charlie and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are longtime friends from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who travel together to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) to begin their studies at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Though they share a history and journey to university as companions, there is an underlying rivalry between them over the good graces of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000), [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 ch.Farewell P4](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0004), +3 more_

- presumed Rival of — rivals in the good graces of a certain damsel with gray eyes (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000)</sub>
- Friend of — longtime friends from Avonlea (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Park P11](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0011)</sub>
